DBF Technical Projects

Structures, Mechanisms, and Design Tools · AIAA DBF

← Back to DBF Overview

A consistent theme runs through the technical work below: given the team’s recent history of not producing a competition-ready aircraft, my co-lead and I prioritized a design philosophy that favored stability, reliability, and integration simplicity over aerodynamic optimization. Click into any project below for the full writeup.

2025-26 Aircraft Design & Configuration →

As Full Team Lead, I directed the overall design of the 2025-26 competition aircraft, determining the overall configuration and setting the subteams on their respective design paths.

MATLAB Design Optimization Program →

A project started last summer, our MATLAB design optimization program serves as the groundwork for our aircraft's initial sizing. The 31-variable MDO framework evaluated 150,000+ candidate designs and directed DF1's configuration.

Carbon Fiber Fuselage & Layup Process →

During my time leading the Mechanical and Structural subteam, I spearheaded the team's transition from a traditional wooden fuselage to a carbon fiber composite one, developing and implementing a layup process.

Banner Deployment & Release Mechanism →

My main technical contribution to DF1, the 3D printed and servo actuated mechanism that deployed and released our aircraft's banner mid flight.

Landing Gear Design (2024–2025) →

My main technical contribution to Jaegerflug (the 2024-25 aircraft), it's landing gear.
